Krillin returns home and has Android 18 shaves his head so he can resume his martial arts training as Goku arrives to spar.

episodes.title: Let's Do It, Omni-King! The Universe's Greatest Martial Arts Tournament!!
episodes.summary: Goku goes and sees Zen-O to get the Tournament of Universes going.

episodes.title: The Gods of Every Universe in Shock?! Losers Erased in the Tournament of Power
episodes.summary: Goku gets an invitation to the Tournament of Power, an epic tournament between universes.

episodes.title: Universe 9's Kicker Basil vs Universe 7's Majin Buu!!
episodes.summary: Majin Buu and Basil the Kicker continue to give Zen-Chan a show while they unravel the fight.

episodes.title: Awaken Your Sleeping Battle Spirit! Son Gohan's Fight!!
episodes.summary: With Majin Buu and Basil's battle concluded, Gohan is the next warrior of Universe 7 to fight. The rusty warrior's opponent is Universe 9's Lavendar. Lavender, however, has a trick up his sleeve

episodes.title: Crusher Bergamo vs. Son Goku! Which Has Sky-High Strength?!
episodes.summary: The greatest fighters of Universes 7 and 9, Goku and Bergamo, face off.

episodes.title: The Righteous Warrior Toppo Bursts In
episodes.summary: After Goku won his battle against Bergamo, Toppo from Universe 11 challenges Goku for fight.

episodes.title: Forming the Universe 7 Representative Team
episodes.summary: With the Zen Exhibition Match concluded and 48 hours until the Tournament of Power, Goku and Gohan search for the 10 warriors needed to complete Universe 7's team.

episodes.title: Son Goku the Talent Scout — Inviting Kuririn and No. 18
episodes.summary: Goku and Gohan spar with Krillin to test his new techniques and his capability of being a member of the Universe 7 team.

episodes.title: The Universes Begin to Make Their Moves: Their Individual Motives
episodes.summary: Goku searches for Majin Buu, as the Supreme Kais of each universe hold a secret meeting without Universe 7.

episodes.title: Trading Blows for the First Time! Android N.17 vs Son Goku!
episodes.summary: Goku travels to an isolated wildlife preserve run by Android 17, and attempts to recruit him for the Tournament of Power.

episodes.title: Hunt the Poachers! Goku and N.17's Joint Battle!
episodes.summary: Goku helps Android 17 pursue poachers from outer space.

episodes.title: Gohan and Piccolo: The Master and Disciple's Intense Training to the Limit!
episodes.summary: In preparation for the tournament, Piccolo trains Gohan so that he may awaken the power he had long ago.

episodes.title: A Mysterious Beauty Appears! Mistery of the Tenshin-Style Dojo?!
episodes.summary: Goku arrives at the dojo run by Tienshinhan to recruit him for the Tournament of Power.

episodes.title: Facing the Wall that Must be Overcome! Goku vs Gohan
episodes.summary: As Gohan fights both his father and Tien, Piccolo attacks his two enemies with a strong technique. This eventually results in the arena getting destroyed ending the match. However, Gohan requests to have a one-on-one fight against his father. Goku accepts and both fight equally, with Goku transforming into a Super Saiyan 2 and Gohan using his full power, aiming to surpass him on his own way. Eventually, Gohan makes Goku become a Super Saiyan Blue and perform his Kaio-Ken technique to have a final exchange in which Gohan is defeated. Impressed with his son's improvement, Goku assigns Gohan as the leader of their team.

episodes.title: Which Universe Will Survive?! The Strongest Warriors Are Gathering!!
episodes.summary: The Warriors that are participating in the tournament are gathering while the tournament draws near other universes are gathering their warriors too.

episodes.title: Emergency Development! The Incomplete Ten Members!!
episodes.summary: Goku races to Mr. Satan's house, where he proves unable to wake Majin Buu from his hibernation. Meanwhile, all of Universe 7's remaining warriors except Master Roshi and No. 17 gather at the Capsule Corporation. After Krillin brings up the 10 million Zeni prize that Goku had bribed him, 18, and Tien with, Piccolo and Gohan reveal that the prize of 10 million Zeni was a lie and that the universe will be destroyed if they lose. When Goku returns, Krillin berates him and threatens to withdraw from the team along with No. 18. After Goku fails to convince them otherwise, Beerus swiftly threatens Krillin into staying, while Bulma agrees to pay out the promised reward. In Universe 6, Cabba takes Caulifla to a deserted wasteland to teach her how to become a Super Saiyan. As Caulifla's protégée, Kale(ケール Kēru ), observes them, Cabba ineffectually attempts to provoke Caulifla in order to make her transform. When that fails, he teaches her to focus her energy on an area in her back. Caulifla successfully transforms into a Super Saiyan. Caulifla tests her newfound power and agrees to join Universe 6's team for the Tournament of Power. Caulifla beckons Kale over to attempt the transformation herself. In Universe 11, Kahseral arrives at the Pride Trooper headquarters, where he and Toppo agree to leave the universe in their trainees' hands so they can participate in the tournament. In Universe 3, two cyborg warriors named Nigrisshi(ニグリシ Nigrisshi )and Narirama(ナリラマ Narirama )display their upgrades for the tournament to Universe 3's deities Mosco(モスコ Mosuko ), Ea(エア), and Campari(カンパーリ Kanpāri ). Back in Universe 7, Goku and his friends are unable to figure out who can replace Buu. When Beerus claims they have no suitable fighters because Goku destroyed the Frieza Force, Goku is inspired to recruit Frieza, which shocks everyone.

episodes.title: You're the 10th Warrior! Goku Visits Freeza!
episodes.summary: In a desperate move to keep the roster for the Tournament, Goku decides to revive his archenemy Frieza so he can compete.

episodes.title: The Emperor of Evil Returns! A Reception of Mysterious Assassins?!
episodes.summary: Frieza is resurrected. However, a group of assassins come for him and Goku.

episodes.title: The Worst! The Most Evil! Frieza's Rampage!!
episodes.summary: Frieza goes on a rampage against the assassins sent to take him out. But if he takes too long, Universe 7 is disqualified and erased from the Tournament.

episodes.title: The Time Is Here! To The World Of Void For The Fate Of The Universe!!
episodes.summary: The Tournament of Power is finally about to begin. Goku and the rest of the team head to the World of Void, site of the battle stage.

episodes.title: Survive! The Tournament of Power Begins at Last!!
episodes.summary: The 80 warriors assemble in the fighting arena in the World of Void and the curtain rises on the battle for survival.

episodes.title: Oh, Uncertainty! A Universe Despairs!!
episodes.summary: The Universe 7 team is hit by a concentrated attack from the other universes.

episodes.title: Show Them! Krillin's True Power!!
episodes.summary: The Universes get a taste of what it's like to be erased, after universe 9 is wiped out of existence, Krillin begins showcasing his newly-found powers. Universe 7 loses it's first participant.

episodes.title: The Berserker Awakens!
episodes.summary: Kale unleashes her berserk Saiyan ability, but endangers her fellow teammates.

episodes.title: The Warrior of Justice Closes In!
episodes.summary: The Pride Troopers of Universe 11 launch an assault on Goku's team.

episodes.title: The Power of Love Explodes?! Universe 2's Little Witch Warriors!!
episodes.summary: The Universe 2 lady fighters make their move.

episodes.title: Gohan be Ruthless! The Showdown with Universe 10
episodes.summary: Gohan goes up against Universe 10 warriors.

episodes.title: A Faster-Than-Light Battle Begins! Goku and Hit's Joint Front!
episodes.summary: Hit and Dispo begin to fight at the speed of light. Hit is disadvantaged when Goku comes to help.

episodes.title: Brave Fight! Muten Roshi Stakes his Life!!
episodes.summary: Master Roshi takes on the fighters of Universe 4.

episodes.title: Find Him! Death Match with an Invisible Attacker!!
episodes.summary: An unknown sniper with incredible aim launches a stealth attack in the Tournament.

episodes.title: Revenge ‘F'! The Cunning Trap?!
episodes.summary: Frost has to decrease the number of the Universe 7 fighters as soon as possible by order of Champa. He offers battle to Kame Sen'nin who is taking a rest.

episodes.title: Frieza and Frost!! Intersecting Evil?!
episodes.summary: Frieza saves Gohan who have a hard fight with Jimeze. Then, Frost appears there, Freiza declares that he joins with Frost.

episodes.title: The Ultimate Enemy Approaches Goku! Now, Let Loose! The Killer Spirit Bomb!
episodes.summary: Goku faces Jiren bravely using his x20 Super Saiyan Blue Kaio-ken form.

episodes.title: Son Goku Wakes! New Level of the Awakened!
episodes.summary: Son Goku goes against Jiren on an epic fight.

episodes.title: Hit vs Jiren!!
episodes.summary: Hit battles Jiren after Goku has been defeated.

episodes.title: Vegeta's Resolve!!
episodes.summary: Cabba is in trouble and facing elimination. Universe 6 is in disarray. Can they rally to turn it around or will they also be wiped from all existence?

episodes.title: Fighting Maniac Saiyan
episodes.summary: Goku is on his feet again but in desperate need of a break to regain his stamina. Goku needs assistance from his team. Other warriors sense an opportunity to despatch a fatigued combatant. In steps Kale. Will she be the one to protect her fellow Saiyan?

episodes.title: Ghastly! Explosive Birth of a New Super Warrior!!
episodes.summary: Kale unleashes the full power of her berserker form again. Caulifla gives words of encouragement for her to control her own power.

episodes.title: Goku vs Kafla!!
episodes.summary: Super Saiyan God Goku is being pushed back by Kefla. Goku comments that he did not expect a Potara Fusion, and Kefla powers up, exclaiming that her bubbling power is out of this world and that nobody can stop her.

episodes.title: The Comeback Omen! Ultra Istinct's Great Explosion!!
episodes.summary: To counter Goku's increase in power, Kefla powers up to Super Saiyan 2 and the two of them face off while Goku continues his efforts to master Ultra Instinct.

episodes.title: Grand Love Shodown! Androids vs Universe 2
episodes.summary: Androids 17 and 18 battle Universe 2.

episodes.title: Accelerating Drama: A Universe Disappears...!
episodes.summary: Goku and Friends face off with the remaining Universe 6 and 2 warriors.

episodes.title: A New Victim from Universe 7! Universe 4 Gets Serious!!
episodes.summary: Universe 7 takes on Universe 4.

episodes.title: A Perfect Survival Strategy! Universe 3's Menacing Assassins!!
episodes.summary: Universe 3 goes on the offensive against Universe 7. Viara confronts No. 17 and No.18. And Dr. Paparoni sends Panchia, Koitsukai, and Bollarator to attack Goku, Gohan and Vegeta.

episodes.title: All-Out War! The Ultimate 4-Way Combination vs Universe 7's Total Offensive!!
episodes.summary: A mini battle royale ensues as Universe seven calls in the entire team to protect their spot in the tournament of power.

episodes.title: For One's Own Pride! Vegeta's Challenge to Be The Strongest!!
episodes.summary: Vegeta has had enough of biding his time. He decides to stick his chest out and enter the fray against the seemingly unbeatable Jiren.

episodes.title: Full Body, Spirit, and Power Unleashed!
episodes.summary: With the tournaments final showdown on its way. Goku and co try to make their numerical advantages count over Dyspo, Toppo and Jiren. Will it be enough? Or will they each have to surpass their current limits to stand a chance?

episodes.title: A Stormy, Fierce Attack! Gohan Fights with his Back to the Wall!!
episodes.summary: Gohan and Frieza fight together against Dyspo.

episodes.title: Advent of the God of Destruction, Toppo! There is Only Overwhelming Power!!
episodes.summary: Toppo reaches overwhelming powers in order to make sure Universe 11 wins and he will be named new God of Destruction.

episodes.title: Surpass Even a God! Vegeta's Life-Risking Blow
episodes.summary: After hurting Android 17 and Frieza with his Hakai, Toppo starts attacking Vegeta. Vegeta was unable to match Toppo's new God of destruction form but he raged himself against Toppo. In end to knock out toppo, Vegeta detonates himself.

episodes.title: The approaching wall! The final barrier of hope!!
episodes.summary: Android 17, Vegeta, Goku and Frieza maximize their struggle to defeat Jiren. Jiren releases his hidden power that surprises everyone. Android 17 shows Jiren his bravery and tries to mentally steer him into defeat. 17, protects Vegeta and Goku from a lethal attack from Jiren.

episodes.title: With Noble Pride to the End! Vegeta Falls!
episodes.summary: While Goku tries to master the Ultra Instinct, Vegeta still fights Jiren with everything he's got.

episodes.title: Trascending the Limit! Mastering Ultra Istinct!!
episodes.summary: A super heated battle for survival continues. With Jiren puttin Goku on the ropes even after he awakens ultra instict Goku surrpasses his limits once again by mastering the ultra instict.

episodes.title: An Unprecedented Super Showdown!!
episodes.summary: The climactic battle to decide the fate of Universe 7 continues as Goku, now mastering Ultra Instinct, fights Jiren at his full power.

episodes.title: Goku, Until the Day We Meet Again
episodes.summary: The Tournament of Power reaches its final climactic moment, as Goku, Frieza and 17 have to eliminate Jiren for the survival of Universe 7.
